scope: Individual review of all 27 changed sources. Original summaries only; publisher bodies stay outside the public tree. No canonical instruction defect established. Retain the freshness checker, marker methods (except the two reviewed Google representation changes), unchanged source pins, global review date and maximum age. No model call, installation, billing change or release. Matching visible text is not proof of byte equality or installed-client behavior. Ten sources had no retained earlier body, so those were checked against the prior finding and affected skills only.
method: Each source was read twice per record with the existing checker user agent and content decoding, plus a separate three-read stability probe. A pin moved only when every read produced the same fingerprint of the same marker kind. Retained October 29 bodies were compared as visible text where available.
